name: NVIDIA Blackwell datasheet (GB200 NVL72 / GB200 NVL4 / HGX B200 technical specifications)
notes: Direct PDF fetch of the Blackwell datasheet (doc 4204213, Oct 25). Technical Specifications table gives per-platform Max TDP as 'Configurable up to 1,200 W' (GB200 NVL72 and NVL4) and 'Configurable up to 1,000 W' (HGX B200). Energy-efficiency footnote quantifies the air-vs-liquid comparison: 'Energy savings for 65 racks eight-way HGX H100 air-cooled versus one rack GB200 NVL72 liquid-cooled'. Footer doc number 4204213, Oct 25.
